facts.fact_text: On 2 April 2011 the first applicant attended an unauthorised opposition demonstration held at Fountains Square in Baku.
On 2 April 2011 the second applicant attended an unauthorised opposition demonstration held at Fountains Square in Baku.
The demonstration held at Fountains Square on 2 April 2011 was intended to be peaceful.
The demonstration held at Fountains Square on 2 April 2011 was conducted in a peaceful manner.
Upon arriving at Fountains Square at around 3 p.m. on 2 April 2011, the first applicant was arrested by police officers.
After his arrest, the first applicant was taken to the Nasimi district police office.
The first applicant was taken to the Nasimi district police office together with other participants in the demonstration, including M.H. and N.S.
After his arrival at the Nasimi district police office, the first applicant was placed in the exercise yard of the temporary detention centre of the Nasimi district police office.
The first applicant was allegedly beaten by S.N., who was the Deputy Head of the Nasimi district police office.
The first applicant was allegedly beaten by a police officer called J.A.
The first applicant was allegedly beaten by a person wearing plain clothes whom the first applicant did not know.
According to the first applicant, S.N. (Deputy Head of the Nasimi district police office) swore at the first applicant.
According to the first applicant, S.N. (Deputy Head of the Nasimi district police office) kicked the first applicant in his abdominal area.
According to the first applicant, S.N. (Deputy Head of the Nasimi district police office) punched the first applicant.
According to the first applicant, after S.N. (Deputy Head of the Nasimi district police office) kicked him in his testicles, the first applicant lost consciousness owing to the severe pain.
According to the first applicant, despite his requests, he was not provided with the requisite medical assistance while in police custody.
The Government maintained that the first applicant had not been subjected to torture or inhuman or degrading treatment in police custody.
The first applicant stated before the Nasimi District Court that he was not guilty of disobeying the lawful order of a police officer.
The first applicant did not have any lawyer at the court hearing before the Nasimi District Court.
The first applicant insisted on being allowed to have a lawyer of his own choice at the court hearing before the Nasimi District Court.
The first applicant requested to invite witnesses to testify on his behalf at the court hearing before the Nasimi District Court.
The judge of the Nasimi District Court disregarded the first applicant's requests to have a lawyer of his own choice and to invite witnesses to testify on his behalf.
The Nasimi District Court found that the first applicant had failed to stop participating in an unauthorised demonstration.
The Nasimi District Court convicted the first applicant under Article 310.1 (failure to comply with a lawful order of a police officer) of the Code of Administrative Offences.
The Nasimi District Court sentenced the first applicant to eight days' administrative detention.

The Nasimi District Court relied on the testimony of police officer A.E., who testified that the first applicant had been attempting to hold an unauthorised demonstration and had continued his actions, disobeying a request to stop participating in the unlawful demonstration.

The Nasimi District Court relied on the testimony of police officer E.S., who testified that the first applicant had been attempting to hold an unauthorised demonstration and had continued his actions, disobeying a request to stop participating in the unlawful demonstration.
During the court hearing on 2 April 2011 before the Nasimi District Court, the first applicant complained that on that day he had been beaten at the police station.

During the court hearing on 2 April 2011 before the Nasimi District Court, the first applicant asked the court to facilitate the provision of the requisite medical assistance, but his request was ignored.
On 4 April 2011 the first applicant lodged an appeal with the Baku Court of Appeal.
In his appeal to the Baku Court of Appeal, the first applicant argued that his arrest had been unlawful.
In his appeal to the Baku Court of Appeal, the first applicant argued that his conviction had been unlawful.

In his appeal to the Baku Court of Appeal, the first applicant argued that the hearing before the Nasimi District Court had not been fair, in particular that he had not been allowed to have a lawyer of his own choice.
In his appeal to the Baku Court of Appeal, the first applicant argued that his procedural application to call witnesses to testify on his behalf had been dismissed by the Nasimi District Court.
In his appeal to the Baku Court of Appeal, the first applicant complained of ill-treatment.
In his appeal to the Baku Court of Appeal, the first applicant stated that he still felt unwell and had not received the requisite medical assistance.
On 8 April 2011 the Baku Court of Appeal dismissed the first applicant's appeal.
The Baku Court of Appeal held that the first applicant had had a State-appointed lawyer at the first-instance court (Nasimi District Court).
The Baku Court of Appeal held that the first applicant's ill-treatment claims had not been proved.
On 6 April 2011 the first applicant lodged a complaint with the Nasimi District Court under the procedure for judicial review of prosecuting authorities' actions or decisions.
In his complaint to the Nasimi District Court, the first applicant relied on Articles 3, 5, 6, 11, 13 and 14 of the Convention and complained regarding his ill-treatment on 2 April 2011.
In his complaint to the Nasimi District Court, the first applicant complained regarding the unfairness of his conviction.
In his complaint to the Nasimi District Court, the first applicant complained regarding the violation of his freedom of assembly.
In his complaint to the Nasimi District Court, the first applicant complained regarding discrimination against him on the basis of his political views.
By a decision of 12 April 2011, the Nasimi District Court refused to admit the first applicant's case.
By a decision of 12 April 2011, the Nasimi District Court sent the first applicant's complaint to the Nasimi district prosecutor's office, claiming that the latter had the authority to consider it.
On an unspecified date in April 2011 the first applicant applied to the Baku prosecutor's office, requesting that a criminal investigation into the matter of his alleged ill-treatment be instituted.
According to a forensic report dated 15 April 2011, there was an abrasion on the first applicant's left calf caused by a blunt object.
According to the forensic report dated 15 April 2011, the abrasion on the first applicant's left calf could have been inflicted on 2 April 2011.
By a decision of 28 April 2011, the Nasimi district prosecutor's office refused to open a criminal case regarding the first applicant's alleged ill-treatment.

The Nasimi district prosecutor's office refused to open a criminal case on the grounds that the first applicant's beating by S.N. (Deputy Head of the Nasimi district police office) had not been proved.
